Multi
Blocker
■ This creature can't attack players.
■ Over Drive—Darkness x1 + Fire x1 + Nature x1 (When you summon this creature, you may tap another 1 darkness, 1 fire and 1 nature card in your mana zone. If you do, this creature gets the following OD ability.)
:OD When you put this creature into the battle zone, if your opponent has more cards in their hand than you have in yours, you may draw until you have the same number of cards as them.

■ O・ドライブ—闇×1・と火×1と自然×1 (このクリーチャーを召喚する時、自分のマナゾーンでさらに闇1枚、と火1枚、自然1枚またはそのいずれかの組み合わせをタップしてもよい。そうした場合、次のOD能力を得る。)
